# Induction analysis

## Load BabyLM data


```{r include=FALSE}
## setwd("/Users/seantrott/Dropbox/UCSD/Research/NLMs/epistemology/mechinterp_generalizability/src/analysis")
directory_path <- "../../data/processed/induction_results_babylm/"
csv_files <- list.files(path = directory_path, pattern = "*.csv", full.names = TRUE)
length(csv_files)
csv_list <- csv_files %>%
  map(~ read_csv(.))


df_models <- bind_rows(csv_list) %>%
  mutate(model = sub("BabyLM-community/", "", mpath))  %>%
  mutate(layer = layer + 1)
nrow(df_models)


### Create head-level summaries
df_babylm_models_head_summaries = df_models %>%
  group_by(mpath, n_params, model,
           layer, head, words_seen) %>%
  summarise(mean_ps = mean(ps),
            mean_ar_acc = mean(ar_acc),
            mean_ar_rank = mean(ar_mean_rank))


```


## Positional analysis

```{r babylm_pos_induction}

### Max by layer
df_babylm_models_head_summaries %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  mutate(total_words_seen = max(words_seen)) %>%
  filter(words_seen == total_words_seen) %>%
  group_by(model, head, layer, n_params) %>%
  summarise(max_mean = max(mean_ps)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = layer,
             y = head,
             fill = max_mean)) +
  geom_tile() +
  labs(x = "Layer",
       y = "Head",
       fill = "Max Prefix-Matching Score") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue",
                       mid = "white",
                       high = "red",
                       midpoint = 0, 
                       name = "Max Prefix-Matching Score") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 15),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0), # Keep facet labels horizontal
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  facet_wrap(~reorder(model, n_params))



### Max by layer
df_by_head_seed = df_babylm_models_head_summaries %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  mutate(total_words_seen = max(words_seen)) %>%
  filter(words_seen == total_words_seen) %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  mutate(z_ps = scale(mean_ps)) 

df_by_head_seed %>%
  group_by(model, head, layer, n_params) %>%
  summarise(max_mean = max(z_ps)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = layer,
             y = head,
             fill = max_mean)) +
  geom_tile() +
  labs(x = "Layer",
       y = "Head",
       fill = "Max Prefix-Matching Score (z-scored)") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue",
                       mid = "white",
                       high = "red",
                       midpoint = 0, 
                       name = "Max Prefix-Matching Score (z-scored)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 15),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0), # Keep facet labels horizontal
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  facet_wrap(~model)


```


## Developmental analysis


## Track AR Score

```{r ar_over_time_babylm}

df_ar_by_step = df_babylm_models_head_summaries %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, words_seen) %>%
  summarise(mean_ar_acc = first(mean_ar_acc),
            mean_ar_rank = first(mean_ar_rank))



df_ar_by_step %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = words_seen,
             y = mean_ar_acc,
             color = model)) +
  geom_line(size = .6) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Words Seen",
       y = "Associative Recall (Accuracy)",
       color = "") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_color_manual(values = viridisLite::viridis(2, option = "mako", 
                                                   begin = 0.8, end = 0.15))




df_ar_by_step %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = words_seen,
             y = mean_ar_rank,
             color = model)) +
  geom_line(size = .6) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Words Seen",
       y = "Associative Recall (Rank)",
       color = "") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_color_manual(values = viridisLite::viridis(2, option = "mako", 
                                                   begin = 0.8, end = 0.15))

```



## Track Max Prefix Score

```{r ps_over_time_babylm}
### Track max PS at each time point for each model (no seeds)
df_by_head_max_attention = df_babylm_models_head_summaries %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, words_seen) %>%
  slice_max(mean_ps)

df_by_head_max_attention %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = words_seen, y = mean_ps, color = model)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Words Seen", y = "Max Prefix-Matching Score", color = "") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 15), legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_color_manual(values = viridisLite::viridis(2, option = "mako", 
                                                   begin = 0.8, end = 0.15))

summary(lm(data = df_by_head_max_attention,
           mean_ps ~ log10(words_seen)))
```

## PS and AR together


```{r ps_and_ar_babylm}

### Track max PS at each time point for each model (no seeds)
df_by_head_max_attention = df_babylm_models_head_summaries %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, words_seen) %>%
  slice_max(mean_ps) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(model, n_params, words_seen, mean_ps, mean_ar_acc, mean_ar_rank) %>%
  distinct()

### Reshape to long for plotting both metrics
df_combined = df_by_head_max_attention %>%
  select(model, n_params, words_seen, 
         `Max Prefix-Matching Score` = mean_ps,
         `Associative Recall (Accuracy)` = mean_ar_acc) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`Max Prefix-Matching Score`, 
                        `Associative Recall (Accuracy)`),
               names_to = "metric",
               values_to = "value")

df_combined %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = words_seen,
             y = value,
             color = metric,
             linetype = metric)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Words Seen",
       y = "Score",
       color = "",
       linetype = "") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Max Prefix-Matching Score" = "#0072B2",
                                "Associative Recall (Accuracy)" = "#009E73")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Max Prefix-Matching Score" = "solid",
                                   "Associative Recall (Accuracy)" = "dotted")) +
  facet_wrap(~reorder(model, words_seen)) +
theme(text = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        panel.spacing.x = unit(2, "lines")) 
```



# 1-back analysis

## Load BabyLM data


```{r include=FALSE}
## setwd("/Users/seantrott/Dropbox/UCSD/Research/NLMs/epistemology/mechinterp_generalizability/src/analysis")
directory_path <- "../../data/processed/attentions_babylm/"
csv_files <- list.files(path = directory_path, pattern = "*.csv", full.names = TRUE)
length(csv_files)
csv_list <- csv_files %>%
  map(~ read_csv(.))


df_babylm_models_1back <- bind_rows(csv_list) %>%
  mutate(model = sub("BabyLM-community/", "", mpath)) %>%
  filter(Layer > 0)
nrow(df_babylm_models_1back)



### Create head-level summaries
df_babylm_models_1back_summaries = df_babylm_models_1back %>%
  mutate(head = Head - 1,
         layer = Layer) %>%
  group_by(n_params, words_seen, model,
           layer, head) %>%
  summarise(mean_1back = mean(`1-back attention`),
            mean_first = mean(first_token)) 

```

## Positional

### 1-back

```{r 1back_babylm_pos}

### Max by layer
df_babylm_models_1back_summaries %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  mutate(total_words_seen = max(words_seen)) %>%
  filter(words_seen == total_words_seen) %>%
  group_by(model, head, layer, n_params) %>%
  summarise(max_mean = max(mean_1back)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = layer,
             y = head,
             fill = max_mean)) +
  geom_tile() +
  labs(x = "Layer",
       y = "Head",
       fill = "Max 1-back Attention") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue",
                       mid = "white",
                       high = "red",
                       midpoint = 0, 
                       name = "Max 1-back Attention") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 15),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0), # Keep facet labels horizontal
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  facet_wrap(~reorder(model, n_params))



```

# Compare 1-back and induction by model

```{r temporal_coordination_babylm}
df_by_head_max_attention_1back = df_babylm_models_1back_summaries%>%
  group_by(model, n_params, words_seen) %>%
  slice_max(mean_1back)

df_by_head_max_attention_induction = df_babylm_models_head_summaries %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, words_seen) %>%
  slice_max(mean_ps)

induction_traj <- df_by_head_max_attention_induction %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, words_seen) %>%
  summarise(max_val = max(mean_ps), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(metric = "Induction (PS)")

oneback_traj <- df_by_head_max_attention_1back %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, words_seen) %>%
  summarise(max_val = max(mean_1back), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(metric = "1-back Attention")

combined <- bind_rows(induction_traj, oneback_traj)

combined %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = words_seen, y = max_val, color = metric)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Words Seen",
       y = "Max attention score",
       color = "") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("1-back Attention" = "#E69F00", 
                                "Induction (PS)" = "#0072B2")) +

  facet_wrap(~reorder(model, words_seen)) +
theme(text = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        panel.spacing.x = unit(2, "lines")) 





```


### All together

```{r babylm_ar_with_attention}
df_by_head_max_attention_1back = df_babylm_models_1back_summaries %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, words_seen) %>%
  slice_max(mean_1back)

df_by_head_max_attention_induction = df_babylm_models_head_summaries %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, words_seen) %>%
  slice_max(mean_ps)

df_ar_traj = df_babylm_models_head_summaries %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, words_seen) %>%
  summarise(mean_ar_acc = first(mean_ar_acc), .groups = "drop")

induction_traj <- df_by_head_max_attention_induction %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, words_seen) %>%
  summarise(max_val = max(mean_ps), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(metric = "Induction (PS)")

oneback_traj <- df_by_head_max_attention_1back %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, words_seen) %>%
  summarise(max_val = max(mean_1back), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(metric = "1-back Attention")

ar_traj <- df_ar_traj %>%
  rename(max_val = mean_ar_acc) %>%
  mutate(metric = "Associative Recall (Acc)")

combined <- bind_rows(induction_traj, oneback_traj, ar_traj)

combined %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = words_seen, y = max_val, 
             color = metric, linetype = metric)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Words Seen",
       y = "Score",
       color = "",
       linetype = "") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("1-back Attention" = "#E69F00", 
                                "Induction (PS)" = "#0072B2",
                                "Associative Recall (Acc)" = "#009E73")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("1-back Attention" = "solid",
                                   "Induction (PS)" = "solid",
                                   "Associative Recall (Acc)" = "dotted")) +
  facet_wrap(~reorder(model, words_seen)) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        panel.spacing.x = unit(2, "lines"))
```
